up_stocks.reasoning: Financials joined the broad rally. Bank Nifty and private banks participated; Shriram’s move reflected NBFC strength alongside the banking up-move.
up_stocks.news: Broad financial gains on the day.

down_stocks.name: Sun Pharma
down_stocks.reasoning: Pharma was one of the few sectors that did not participate in the broad rally. Relative underperformance after recent strength; some post-earnings / US-sales related caution remained in the name.
down_stocks.news: Notable Nifty loser while most sectors were green.

down_stocks.name: Apollo Hospitals
down_stocks.reasoning: Had run hard into record-high territory; the broad up-day became an opportunity for profit-booking in an extended name. Classic ‘sell the strength’ behaviour after a parabolic stretch.
down_stocks.news: Among the top losers on an otherwise strong day.

down_stocks.name: Maruti Suzuki
down_stocks.reasoning: Auto lagged the broad rally. While IT, financials and metals surged, Maruti did not attract the same flows — relative underperformance inside an otherwise risk-on session.
down_stocks.news: Among Sensex names that finished lower.

down_stocks.name: Bharti Airtel
down_stocks.reasoning: Telecom stayed out of the leadership group. No major positive catalyst on the day while capital rotated into IT and financials.
down_stocks.news: Telecom remained under relative pressure.
down_stocks.trend_note: Soft while the index made multi-month highs.

down_stocks.name: ONGC / Tech Mahindra
down_stocks.reasoning: ONGC: crude volatility cut both ways — the same crude drop that helped airlines and the macro narrative was less helpful for upstream oil. TechM: lagged the stronger IT names (TCS/Infosys) inside the sector rally.
down_stocks.news: Relative underperformers within their groups.
